content: Thank you so much for taking your time to answer this! I will definitely consider your points and wait for ghelot as you said.
What team composition would you suggest based on my current rooster?
GLot, not GHelot 😉

With what you got so far I'd try Tulu-Saya-Aurita-Murphy

Unfortunately you won't be able to fully benefit from Saya but her 0-cost is insane as is.

- Tulu unleashes lots of tentacle attack to trigger the corrosion,

- Murphy does as well and boost tentacle damage.

- Aurita, again, triggers tent atracks but also benefits from the discard provided by Saya

- Saya cycles command cards ( *only command cards* > not symptoms, rouse or neutral cards like posse cards ) and applies lots of corrosion

Since you're a newcomer I wouldn't worry too much ablut your linup. The early chapters are lenient enough that you can fiddle with your team and pull through.

I suggest to take that opportunity to try as many awakeners and combinations as you can

Try building a team around Aurita, since she's a free unit nuke she gives tons of damage that takes out the heads if you set up her nuke right. You can get free copies of her enlightenments in the shop. She works really well with Corposant who gives the whole team tons of survivability. 

Aequor teams are really strong and are great for mainstory content, so do pull on them in the standard banner. Caecus and Celeste are nice supports.

I'm also a new player (<1 month) in and I've been able to cruise mainstory content with Aurita-Corpo-Miryam-Casiah, until Chapter 7-1 where I am at now.

Hey guys, so i literally just started playing the game 3 days ago, and I was just wondering if it'd be smarter for me, as an f2p, to invest into one team (vertical), or if its better to get a bunch of characters and invest later? (Horizontal) <:What:1356085150869622965> 

Currently im planning to pull for E3 Pollux, and then hopefully get Horla from the Moonless Guide banner, then pull her E1 when she reruns and hopefully also get Castor for Pollux team (in the meantime I'll run him with Aigis, Horla and E0 Thais), would that be a good idea or again, should i just get the bare minimum and try getting more characters and then invest into Pollux slowly? If it changes anything, my current main objective is just to clear main/side stories, i usually dont touch endgame at all until I've got the units and teams for it.

- (erm side question...<:Karen_guilty:1468258923009282140> , I have E0 Thais, E0 Tawil and E1 Miryam so far, should i stop pulling now on Moonless Guide and just put my pulls into getting Pollux and then go for E0/E1 Horla on her rerun or do i keep pulling in hopes of getting Horla or more dupes?)

Your progression (at least in terms of endgame) will be faster with horizontal progression. One of the main endgame modes is D-Zone which rotates on a biweekly basis. You need up to 5 teams (technically 4 since you can use a support carry) or even more to try and fully claim all the rewards. 

Those biweekly rewards and endgame materials disappear, but you will always have access to the story. (Do note, progressing through the story is a great way to get more pull materials and progression rewards. You need to figure out the balance of trying to get DTide rewards and progressing more.) At level 60, pretty much any unit of the game can clear Wave 1 in a team of then, so you will inevitably start beating DTide stuff as you accumulate more and more resources. 

Pollux is a strong carry, but the future rerunning character “Mouchette” (who is coming on the next triple banner) is the current strongest DPS in the game. It’s recommended to pull for her as she can form her own team and heavily help with story progression in endgame. 

For the moonless banner, it’s up to you. None of your characters are at significant “breakpoints” where they are considered significantly stronger with more enlightenments. However, if you just want Horla, you will save a lot more pulls trying to get her to E1 with her dedicated banner.

I'll keep pulling on moonless guide then in hopes of Horla but more so E2 Tawil or E2 Thais <:Sparxie_ThumbsUp:1480771795970818098> . 

Tysm for the advice btw <:bf_hearts:1442718040117608498> , I'm not really used to playing endgame very early on, usually its takes me months for me to be bothered, but I'll definitely try my best, cause missing out on the rewards would be worse.
Omg sorry for the very long answer <:Horla_cry:1357186646294138890>

The purpose of pulling characters USUALLY is to form teams around them for usage in DZone (if you think someone is cool tho, just pull for them. It’s just a game). 

Horizontal progression just means investing into multiple teams. It’s up to you to choose whether you spend the dupes and save pulls or spend the pulls and save the dupe item. 

If you are focused on progression as a F2P, just remember to focus on building teams. What characters do I need? What enlightenments do my characters require to function? Stuff like that.

It’s quite hard to brick tbf. I’d still recommend you to pull Mouchette for a team in the future even if you don’t play her now. 

Just keep the breakpoints in mind on Moonless. Those are good breakpoints for those characters you mentioned (Horla’s is E1). 

When I first started, I was in a similar boat to you. There is a significant portion of endgame content that seems to be unlocked very fast and it was a little overwhelming; however, it pushed me out of comfort zone and it honestly led to me enjoying the game as a whole more. If you try to do endgame content, it will not only help with progression but also directly improve your skill. 

Good luck!

Heyo there : )
You have quite a nice roster indeed for a starter so there are several teams available to you.

I can recommand Saya-Thaïs-Corposant-Aurita ( or Celeste until you get Aurita for free ) but discard gets a bit technical.

Still, I suggest you check whos available on what banner and try them, see if you want to pull for them.

I myself will not chase after +12 wheels ( especially as f2p ) but getting at least 1 copy of any WoD that synergize with your teams might be worth it ( that's 19 wheels minus the limited ones )
Every month you can buy selectors so your main awakeners can get to E3 easily given a bit of time

Myeah, just to be clear it's 1 selector for an awakener and 1 for a wheel per month.

You can try Pontos-Caecus-Faint-Uvash
Some counter with Pontos for support and Uvash in case you face single-hit enemies.
Not sure about this one, I'd rather go Wanda-Faint for counter
Nympha-Agripa-GDoll-Aigis/Leigh for poison
Murphy-GMurphy-Tulu-Myriam for tentacules fast scaling ( Murphy delays incomming damages and helps mitigate GMurphy's sacrifices )

Arachne-Cassiah-Castor-Karen
Arachne's final verdit is a sure kill and bypasses both heal and shield but you need to stay alive long enough. Castor helps with that. Karen is there for the arithmetica and Cassiah is there for mayhem ( and getting rid of symptoms )

That's about it for what I can think of at a glance.

*But* please do keep in my these suggestions are related to the way *I* play.
In the end, the best team will be the one you put together yourself for a reason. Also, I'm no adept of minimaxing so there are obviously tweaks and swaps to be made for higher difficulties
